title: Independent category amount semantics
description: Validated for v1: each Category Budget Entry is an independent non-negative exact ZAR amount; explicit zero differs from omission; the computed total is informative rather than a separately enforced envelope cap. Narrowed for bd-3lrk by DD-BUDGET-CATEGORY-ENVELOPE-RESOLUTION: an omitted Spend Category yields Unbudgeted Spend only when no element of the Budget Actual's frozen Spend Category ancestry carries an entry; otherwise the nearest ancestry entry governs, and an explicit zero-amount descendant entry terminates that scan.
